name: repository
description: A repository of the snapshot, the subject of facts about files that belong to no module, such as a compose file in a deployment repository. Its key is the repository's name. It has no C4 level.

name: redis-use
description: The subject (a method, a type or a module) uses Redis in the way the value names: template (operations on Redis through a Spring Data Redis template), hash (a @RedisHash type kept as Redis hashes), session (Spring Session's Redis store), rate-limiter (the gateway's RedisRateLimiter), lock (a Redis lock registry), cache (a Redis cache manager or spring.cache.type=redis), pubsub (publishing or subscribing to channels) or client (a Redis client among the module's dependencies). Which server is the config's; the linker matches them.

api.description: The binary name of the type whose method or annotation it is, or the dependency's artifact ID.

operation.description: What the call does with the data.

structure.description: The Redis data structure the operation is made on: value, hash, list, set, zset, stream, geo or hyperloglog.

key.description: The key as the code writes it, with * for what it does not write out, such as bff:session:*.

channel.description: The channel a message is published to, written as for key.

hash.description: The keyspace of a @RedisHash type: its value, else its class name.

namespace.description: The Redis namespace a Spring Session store is configured with.

ttl.description: The time to live written out, such as 600s or 30m.

source.description: Present when the use is shown by a dependency or by config rather than by code.

configKey.description: The config key that shows the use.

name: redis-image
description: A compose file of the subject repository runs a Redis (or Valkey, Redis Stack) image, as the value writes it. The linker takes the data store's technology from it.

technology.description: The product with its version, such as Redis 8.4.0; without a version when the tag names none.

service.description: The compose service that runs it.
